Inter and Playfair Display are sourced from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter and https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/playfairdisplay.
These locally hosted WOFF2 subsets retain Latin and punctuation glyphs. The Playfair derivative is internally renamed Digits Editorial Subset to respect the reserved font name. Original authorship and SIL OFL licence texts are retained in the adjacent OFL files.
IBM Plex Sans Arabic is unchanged.
